verification.currentnessAndScope: Berlin Open Data record updated 2026-09-22. Berlin Senatsverwaltung says ALKIS WFS/WMS is updated monthly and covers Berlin. verification.directProbeBlocker: Local urllib/curl cannot resolve external hosts in this sandbox; prior direct curl reported a self-signed certificate in chain. Official WFS GetCapabilities can be reached by web reader (XML type unsupported), but the web reader cannot return the outputFormat=application/json query body. Do not disable TLS validation or claim a fresh exact-ID query.
verification.fieldsAndIdentity: Official ALKIS schema lists `uuid` as Objekt-ID (feature object ID), `fsko` as Flurstückskennzeichen. Saved GeoJSON sample exposes `uuid` and WFS feature id (`flurstuecke.<uuid>`); sample had no `fsko` property. ALKIS Berlin object catalogue states Flurstückskennzeichen is object-forming. Prefer confirm availability and exact filtering of fsko before persisting it; uuid is the verified returned native field but long-term parcel continuity semantics were not established in this bounded turn.

crs: Native EPSG:25833 (ETRS89 / UTM 33N); WFS sample requests EPSG:4326 GeoJSON output.
